name: cache-clock
description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm after the last model request, warns before it lapses, and flags a cache miss when one happens.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request starts. Claude Code sessions use 60; drops to 5 under usage overage.

warnMinutes.title: Warn at (minutes left)
warnMinutes.description: Show the band and a toast when this much of the window remains.

missTokens.title: Miss threshold (tokens)
missTokens.description: A request that writes at least this many cache tokens while reading fewer than it wrote counts as a cache miss.
